entity_model.school_knowledge_skill: Source-grounded curriculum knowledge or skill; not automatically a semantic identity.
entity_model.semantic_identity: Stable route-independent mathematical capability/concept identity admitted after source review.
entity_model.prerequisite_relation: Source-reviewed directional dependency between admitted semantic identities.
entity_model.exam_route_mapping: Mapping from a semantic identity to profile/base route and year-specific exam structure.
entity_model.exam_task: Exam-position/taxonomy entity; never sufficient alone to define semantic identity.
entity_model.learner_evidence: Observed learner event expressed through the shared PEIS EvidenceEvent contract.

Identity must have stable ID, label, scope, source provenance and route mapping evidence.
Different exam tasks may map to one identity; one exam task may require multiple identities.
Prerequisite edges require separate source review and provenance; course order and exam order are insufficient.
No canonical semantic identity is admitted by this foundation artifact.
